video_title: Draymond Green on Predicting NBA Finals Winner, Losing to Kevin Hart & Joy in Steve Kerr’s Ejection

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on his complicated love-hate relationship with Steve Kerr
quotes.excerpt: I think he hates me and then loves me. It's a little skewed, but I earned it.

text_blocks.speaker: Jimmy Kimmel
text_blocks.text: Your coach Steve Kerr, with whom you have a love-hate relationship, is it fair to say?

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: Very fair. I think he hates me and then loves me. It's a little skewed, but I earned it.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green finds joy in seeing his teammates or coaches get ejected
quotes.excerpt: Nothing makes me more happy to see a player on my team get a tech or ejected.
quotes.quote: Nothing makes me more happy to see a player on my team get a tech or ejected, or my coach get a tech or ejected. Because usually it's me. So I actually like to see how it looks when the shoe is on the other foot. It brings me great joy.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green reflects on his first All-Star selection in 2016
quotes.excerpt: This is 2016, my first time becoming an All-Star. No one really knows who I am.
quotes.quote: This is 2016, my first time becoming an All-Star. No one really knows who I am. Kevin Hart is a big star. Everyone says the NBA is rigged, right? They told me Kevin sucks, so you have to miss shots. They set me up because he's the bigger star.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Charles Barkley's transition to NBA media
quotes.excerpt: Charles Barkley is probably the biggest name in basketball when it comes to media personality.
quotes.quote: Charles Barkley is probably the biggest name in basketball when it comes to media personality, maybe the funniest guy in the history of sports. This is his first time doing the NBA Finals after 30 years, and I'm so honored to have this opportunity.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green predicts the New York Knicks will win the series
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks are going to win.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks are going to win.
